input.command: cd /workspace && find . -type f -not -path './.git/*' | sort && echo '---' && ls -la dotenv tests .yecoding
cd /workspace && cat -n dotenv/variables.py && echo '=====TESTS=====' && cat -n tests/test_acceptance.py

cd /workspace && grep -n "parse_variables\|resolve_variables\|interpolate\|class DotEnv\|def dotenv_values\|def set_key\|def get_key\|def find_dotenv\|def load_dotenv" dotenv/main.py dotenv/parser.py dotenv/__init__.py dotenv/cli.py
cd /workspace && sed -n '1,120p' dotenv/main.py && echo '--- resolve ---' && sed -n '225,250p' dotenv/main.py
cd /workspace && sed -n '250,275p' dotenv/main.py && echo '--- files headers ---' && head -25 dotenv/parser.py && echo '--- init ---' && sed -n '1,60p' dotenv/__init__.py
cd /workspace && python -m unittest discover -s tests -v 2>&1 | tail -30

cd /workspace && echo "== git ==" && (git status --short 2>&1 | head -20; git log --oneline -3 2>&1 | head -5) && echo "== line counts ==" && wc -l dotenv/*.py tests/*.py && echo "== tree ==" && find . -type f -not -path './.yecoding/*' -printf '%p\t%s bytes\n' | sort

cd /workspace && echo "== who imports variables ==" && grep -rn "variables\|parse_variables\|resolve_variables\|Literal\|Variable(" --include=*.py . | grep -v '.yecoding' && echo "== test inventory ==" && grep -n "def test_\|class " tests/test_acceptance.py
cd /workspace && python -V && (command -v pytest || echo "pytest: not on PATH") && python -c "import pytest" 2>&1 | tail -1 && ls /usr/local/bin | head -30
cd /workspace && python -m unittest discover -s tests -v 2>&1 | head -40
